company.shortDescription: CoCoon is your full-service innovation platform for you to access startups and technology investments.
company.description:
With 70 years of multi-generational global business operations based in Hong Kong, we understand first hand the challenges of embracing the success formulas from the past while transforming for the future. We invested, built and opened up CoCoon because we believe that entrepreneurs are the key to enable existing businesses a bridge to innovation, evolution, survival and delivering value to society. A society with thriving businesses enables good jobs, self-actualization, prosperity and peace.

VISION: At CoCoon, we envision generations of pioneers leading the world into a sustainable future.
MISSION: Our mission is to be the global home for founders, investors and thought leaders who are building, investing and predicting the future.

CoCoon is your full-service innovation platform for you to access startups and technology investments. CoCoon is a Google for Startups Partner based in Hong Kong.
